name: Easy Cheesy Jalapeño Cornbread & Ground Beef Taco Bake Casserole

instructions.primary_message: This recipe uses Krustez cornbread and muffin mix; if using a different brand please adjust recipe ingredients and cooking times per package instructions.
Wash and dry green onions and bell pepper. Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces; place in a small bowl and set aside for serving. Trim, seed, and medium dice bell pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ small bunch green onion (scallion)
1 red bell pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add bell pepper, beef, salt, and black pepper; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
680 g lean ground beef
1 tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, prepare cornbread mix according to package instructions, using milk, oil, and egg. Once the batter is prepared, add cheese and stir once more to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (425 g) box cornbread or muffin mix
⅔ cup whole milk
⅓ cup neutral vegetable oil
1 egg
2 cups cheddar cheese, shredded

instructions.primary_message: When the beef is done, add corn, tomato sauce, and taco seasoning to the skillet. Stir to combine, then transfer the beef mixture to a large baking dish, spreading out in an even layer. Top with cornbread mix and jalapeños. Place in the oven and bake until a toothpick inserted in the center of the cornbread comes out clean, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (432 g) can whole kernel corn, canned
213 ml tomato sauce
1 (28 g) pkg taco seasoning

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide cornbread bake between plates or bowls. Top with sour cream and green onions. Enjoy!
